item.title: Jessie Buckley’s Kerry hometown of Killarney takes center stage
item.description: Tourism Ireland is shining a light on the Kerry town’s wild beauty, family legacy and the Oscar winner’s rise.

item.title: Foo Fighters’ Other Voices performance to air on RTÉ this Easter Monday
item.description: Other Voices presents a legendary night of music as Foo Fighters bring their stadium anthems to St James’ Church, Dingle.

item.title: Did you know the Irish have 90 words to describe potatoes?
item.description: We know it's a stereotype, but the Irish really do love potatoes so much so that the humble spud has had quite an influence on the Irish language!

item.title: The best Irish names for your dog
item.description: Trying to choose a name for your dog? Why not draw some inspiration from Ireland and the Irish language. From fearsome hounds of Irish lore to beloved Irish figures, there are many great options for Irish dog names. Here's IrishCentral's official list of the best Irish names for your pup.

item.title: Man’s body found after fire at same house where young boy and grand-aunt were killed
item.description: A man has died following a house fire, in the same residence where a young boy and his grand-aunt were killed just a few months ago.

item.title: Salted caramel and Irish whiskey cake recipe
item.description: County Kilkenny chef Edward Hayden's salted caramel and Irish whiskey cake recipe combines traditional Irish ingredients to create a deliciously decadent dessert!

item.title: DNA test led a Chicago woman to find family ties to Mrs. O’Leary of the Great Fire fame
item.description: A DNA test kit revealed to a Chicago woman that she is a distant relative of Catherine O'Leary, an Irishwoman who was blamed for starting the Great Chicago Fire.

item.title: How has the role of women in Ireland changed in a generation?
item.description: Modern Ireland is a cosmopolitan progressive country, IrishCentral and Herstory asked our community about how life has changed for the women of Ireland. Specifically, we asked, "How has the role of women in Ireland changed in a generation?"

item.title: 10 Irish names that were given to less than three babies in 2025
item.description: As expected, Irish names were a hit amongst parents in 2025, featuring heavily in the charts for both boys and girls.

item.title: Revealed how the Irish accent is perceived and why Northern Irish voices are misunderstood
item.description: An accent coach says Southern Irish accents are often perceived as warm and trustworthy, while Northern Irish speech is still too often misread.
